description: Read content of a text file (any text/* MIME type, e.g. text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv). For Google Docs, use readGoogleDoc.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

fileId.description: ID of the file to read

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters (Unicode code points) to return; content beyond this is truncated

name: readTextFile
